new_result: Even for A=I_3 and strictly positive analytic-Schwartz iid cap-one marginals, the continuous output densities have no common modulus of continuity. A uniformly tight sequence has common height <=2pi yet characteristic functions satisfy |phi_m(tau_m)|>=27/512 at tau_m->infinity. A companion hard-edge formula p(t)=2pi prod_j f_j(0) sqrt(t)+o(sqrt(t)) shows alpha-Hölder regularity fails for every alpha>1/2 even for one analytic target source.
proof_mechanism: Choose unit-measure phase-aligned sets E_tau subset [1,3] by nonstationary periodic averaging, Gaussian-smooth them at source-dependent scales while preserving cap one and a quadratic Fourier coefficient >=3/8, then use independence to obtain a nondecaying output coefficient. Uniform tightness plus a hypothetical common continuity modulus and the direct ||p||_infinity<=2pi bound would imply uniform Fourier decay by Arzela-Ascoli plus a finite-net Riemann-Lebesgue argument, contradiction.
